# Dr. Ali Alheneiti — Cosmetic Dentistry, Amman, Jordan (Full)

Dr. Ali Alheneiti is a cosmetic dentist in Amman, Jordan, offering natural-looking
dental veneers, Hollywood Smile design, dental implants, teeth whitening,
orthodontics, and gummy smile treatment. The clinic serves local patients as well
as international and GCC patients travelling to Jordan for dental treatment
(dental tourism).

Location: Amman, 4th Circle, next to the French Embassy.
Contact: WhatsApp +962 79 016 9494 (https://wa.me/962790169494).
Languages: Arabic and English.

The website is bilingual: English at /en and Arabic at /ar.

Services:
- Dental Veneers in Jordan — natural veneer planning around facial features.
- Teeth Whitening in Amman — professional whitening with sensitivity assessment.
- Dental Implants in Amman — single-tooth and multi-tooth implant planning.
- Orthodontics in Amman — braces and clear aligners with cosmetic-aware planning.
- Gummy Smile Treatment in Jordan — Botox, laser gum contouring, or orthodontics.

The site publishes detailed patient guides on Hollywood Smile cost and design,
veneers (cost, risks, and natural results), veneers vs Hollywood Smile, dental
implant cost/pain/recovery, veneers vs implants, and dental tourism in Jordan.

All treatment content includes a medical disclaimer and is for general education;
it does not replace a personalized dental examination.
